proposal.reason: Primary change is in P2P IPC transport/proxy registration: multi-segment export/import, per-segment FD query/cleanup, mapped-size/offset handling, and proxy-side deregistration lifecycle in src/transport/p2p.cc and proxy interfaces. Added memory module because alloc/register semantics changed independently (segment-aware hgMem free/unmap helpers and callback-draining before pcclCommDeregister) to preserve registration ownership and safe teardown.
